title: attachment survives service restart and reload
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA Cloud / S3
testCommand: cf restart idts-sap01-srv; npm run btp:demo:check; authenticated attachment metadata and content readback
actualResult: After the controlled CAP service restart, the service returned to 1/1 and the readiness gate reported DEMO READY. The active metadata row remained present and the downloaded object still had 131 bytes with the identical SHA-256.
assertions: CAP returned to one running instance after restart.
The BTP readiness gate passed with liveness 200, database readiness 200 and protected anonymous API 401.
The active attachment metadata row remained present after reload.
The post-restart content was 131 bytes and retained the exact original SHA-256.
limitations: This proves persistence across a service restart, not a new deployment. Normal Fiori attachment rendering was confirmed separately by DonHV.
